Motion2MixamoRig (github.com/MaxLiu22/Motion2MixamoRig, code Apache-2.0, experimental): a video of one person, whole body in frame, becomes motion on a Mixamo character (.glb for Blender/Unreal); Blender add-on tested on Apple Silicon, slow but fine on CPU (3-15 min per 30 s clip). Fills the gap Mixamo's library leaves: Lagos-only moves (basin on the head, conductor hanging off the door, frying akara, bargaining, climbing on an okada), filmed by the owner or friends who agree, never strangers' clips. **Catch:** it needs SMPL-X, non-commercial by default (a commercial licence is a separate deal), and the GVHMR weights have their own licence: use it for study and prototypes (person spots), then licence it or redo final animations with a sale-cleared tool before shipping. To set up (needs the owner's OK): repo + Python packages; about 5 GB of weights on first run; the SMPL-X file (owner signs up on the SMPL-X site); a Mixamo FBX from the owner's Adobe account. Mixamo itself: free library, retarget onto City Sample/MetaHuman in Unreal; usable in a shipped game, raw files not shared.

Lagos buildings and their parts: a catalogue for the Gidi generator: Rule zero: this is pattern research. Nothing here names a building to copy; Gidi invents its own.

Civic and public-service buildings: a catalogue for the Gidi generator: Scope: hospitals, clinics, chemists, police (stations, command, posts, checkpoints, barracks), fire, government offices, customs, prison, army, courts, cemeteries, post offices, traffic/task-force posts, and power-company offices and transformers. This builds on `docs/look/research-buildings.md` sections 10.7, 10.8, 10.11 and 10.12, and on `docs/look/research-street.md` sections 2.2 and 3.8. It goes further and does not repeat those sections.

Gidi commerce catalogue: markets, shops, commerce and industry: Purpose: specs for the seeded Blender kit. This builds on `docs/look/research-buildings.md` §6 (shop bays, container shop, kiosk, stall, plaza) and `docs/look/research-street.md` §6 (stall goods, umbrellas, chairs, generators, water tanks, night light). Those base specs are **not repeated**. Where they apply, this file refers to them as `B§6.x` and `S§6.x`.

Lagos housing types beyond the front/back house: a catalogue for the Gidi kit: Scope: every housing type (and the housing-adjacent structures that sit on residential plots) that the Gidi census lists, other than the generic front/back house that `docs/look/research-buildings.md` already covers. This file builds on that document (§0 constants, §1 rooming house, §7 Brazilian house, §8 stilt house, §9 elite) and goes deeper. It does not repeat its paint palette, weathering grammar or sandcrete constants. Use those as the base layer.

Lagos landmarks as patterns: a catalogue for Gidi's invented landmarks: Rule zero applies here more than anywhere else. A landmark is the thing a player will recognise, so **every Gidi landmark must be an original design**. Real Lagos structures appear below only as references for a *type*: what makes that kind of thing striking, how big it is, what it is made of and how it ages. Each item ends with 1-2 invented Gidi designs that share the spirit but not the silhouette of any real one.

Gidi catalogue: education, sport, leisure and nightlife places: This catalogue extends `docs/look/research-buildings.md` and `docs/look/research-street.md`. It does not repeat their walls, gates, roofs, generators, umbrellas, plastic chairs or crowd tables. It reuses them by name: "compound wall (buildings §4)", "event canopy (street §6.3)".

Gidi look research: religious buildings and places: Scope: mosques, churches, white-garment churches, prayer camps, storefront worship, roadside prayer spaces, traditional shrines and festival structures, and how each one sits in the street. Builds on `docs/look/research-buildings.md` §10.5–10.6 and `research-street.md` (loudspeakers, banners, Friday/Sunday dress). This file goes deeper. It does not repeat those sections.

Gidi ground catalogue: roads in every condition, drains, ground, water, vegetation, refuse: This catalogue covers the honest Lagos: roads that are mud with potholes of water, mushy laterite lanes, failed asphalt, choked drains. It builds on `docs/look/research-street.md` §1 and §6.7–6.9, and does not repeat what is there: road widths by class, kerb paint colours, median types, basic drain sizes, basic pothole density, the tree census. It goes deeper on **condition** and on **how to select it from data**.

Gidi street catalogue: roads, vehicles, people, signage, props: This is research for a procedural generator. It studies real Lagos and describes patterns only. Every brand is described generically, and Gidi must invent its own names, liveries and slogans.
